answer: An agent economy can tie each identity to a live ocean signal: every epoch a public tide beacon publishes a fresh reading, and each agent must compute and sign the delta from the previous reading within minutes, using its own key. The delta is unpredictable until the beacon lands, so nothing can be pre-written or batched — a farm running a thousand heads must run a thousand separate live observations, each signed after the signal arrives. Heads that submit identical deltas or move in lockstep lose their locked stake.
